This '''national electoral calendar for 2020''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2020 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*5 January: 
**[[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2019–20 Croatian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan]], [[2019–20 Uzbek parliamentary election|Legislative Chamber (2nd round)]]
*9 January: ''[[Elections in Sint Maarten|Sint Maarten]], [[2020 Sint Maarten general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Elections now set for January 9, 2020 |url=https://www.thedailyherald.sx/islands/91448-elections-now-set-for-january-9-2020 |newspaper=St. Maarten Daily Herald |location=[[Philipsburg, Sint Maarten|Philipsburg]] |access-date=December 23, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191223233540/https://www.thedailyherald.sx/islands/91448-elections-now-set-for-january-9-2020 |archive-date=December 23, 2019 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*11 January: [[Elections in Taiwan|Taiwan]], [[2020 Taiwanese presidential election|President]] and [[2020 Taiwanese legislative election|Parliament]]
*19 January: [[Elections in Comoros|Comoros]], [[2020 Comorian legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]]<ref name="comores-infos.net">{{cite web|url=http://www.comores-infos.net/le-premier-tour-des-elections-legislatives-aura-lieu-le-19-janvier-2020|title=The first round of the legislative elections will take place on January 19, 2020|website=Comores-Infos|access-date=December 23, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191211203818/http://www.comores-infos.net/le-premier-tour-des-elections-legislatives-aura-lieu-le-19-janvier-2020/|archive-date=December 11, 2019|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|fr}}</ref>
*23 January: ''[[Politics of Tokelau|Tokelau]], [[2020 Tokelauan general election|Legislature]]''
*26 January: [[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2020 Peruvian parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==February==
*8 February: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[2020 Irish general election|Parliament]]
*9 February: 
**[[Elections in Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan]], [[2020 Azerbaijani parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/azerbaijan-president-sets-snap-parliamentary-elections-for-february/30309391.html|title=Azerbaijan's President Sets Snap Parliamentary Elections For February|work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]|date=5 December 2019}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Cameroon|Cameroon]], [[2020 Cameroonian parliamentary election|National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cameroon-info.net/article/cameroon-mandates-of-councillors-mps-to-be-extended-until-2020-345594.html|title=Cameroon: Mandates of Councilors, MPs to be extended until 2020|website=Cameroon-Info|date=19 June 2019|access-date=9 November 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190820075933/http://www.cameroon-info.net/article/cameroon-mandates-of-councillors-mps-to-be-extended-until-2020-345594.html|archive-date=20 August 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2020 Swiss referendums#February referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.admin.ch/gov/en/start/documentation/votes.html|title=Popular vote on 09.02.2020|publisher=Switzerland Federal Council|access-date=2019-12-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200205140743/https://www.admin.ch/gov/en/start/documentation/votes.html|archive-date=2020-02-05|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*21 February: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2020 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/443261/Huge-turnout-at-Feb-polls-would-strengthen-national-security|title=Huge turnout at Feb. polls would strengthen national security, says MP|work=[[Tehran Times]]|date=21 December 2019|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
*22 February: [[Elections in Togo|Togo]], [[2020 Togolese presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.yahoo.com/togo-hold-elections-february-next-151007475.html|title=Togo to hold elections in February next year|work=[[Agence France-Presse]]|date=6 December 2019|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
*23 February: [[Elections in Comoros|Comoros]], [[2020 Comorian legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref name="comores-infos.net"/>
*29 February: [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2020 Slovak parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==March==
*1 March: [[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2020 Tajik parliamentary election|Assembly of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news|title=No Debate, No Competition, No Surprises: It's A Tajik Election |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/no-debate-no-competition-no-surprises--its-a-tajik-election/30460217.html|work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]|date=28 February 2020|access-date=1 March 2020}}</ref>
*2 March: 
**[[Elections in Guyana|Guyana]], [[2020 Guyanese general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Guyana votes amid high hopes over oil discoveries |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51544071 |date=2 March 2020 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=2 March 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Israel|Israel]], [[2020 Israeli legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |author=Staff reporter |title=Israeli politicians to pass special law to avoid Purim election clash |url=https://www.thejc.com/news/israel/israeli-politicians-to-pass-special-law-to-avoid-purim-election-clash-vkobnbai |newspaper=[[The Jewish Chronicle]] |location=[[London]], [[United Kingdom|UK]] |date=9 December 2019 |access-date=10 December 2019}}</ref>
*19 March: [[Elections in Vanuatu|Vanuatu]], [[2020 Vanuatuan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Over 21,000 Voter Yet to Vote|url=https://dailypost.vu/news/over-voters-yet-to-vote/article_de24b95c-6a2c-11ea-babc-4708c284e7aa.html|date=20 March 2020|work=[[Vanuatu Daily Post]]|access-date=23 June 2020}}</ref>
*22 March: 
**''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2020 Abkhazian presidential election|President]]''<ref>{{cite news |last=Scollon |first=Michael |title=Breakaway Abkhazia Set To Hold Election Under Cloud Of Controversy, Coronavirus |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-abkhazia-election-controversy-coronavirus-/30500228.html |date=20 March 2020 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=21 March 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Guinea|Guinea]], [[2020 Guinean legislative election|Parliament]]<ref name="Guinea-Referendum"/> and [[2020 Guinean constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref name="Guinea-Referendum">{{cite news |title=Guineans heading to polls in historic constitution vote |url=https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1487770.html |date=22 March 2020 |work=[[RTL Group|RTL Today]] |agency=[[Agence France-Presse]] |access-date=22 March 2020 |archive-date=22 March 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200322050532/https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1487770.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*29 March: [[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2020 Malian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
*31 March: ''[[Elections in Artsakh|Artsakh]], [[2020 Artsakhian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://armenpress.am/eng/news/1001993/|title=Artsakh's general elections to take place on March 31, 2020|work=[[Armenpress]]|date=20 January 2020|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>

==April==
*14 April: 
**''[[Elections in Artsakh|Artsakh]], [[2020 Artsakhian general election|President (2nd round)]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Nagorno-Karabakh Election Runoff Under Way Amid Criticism, Coronavirus Concerns |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/nagorno-karabakh-election-runoff-under-way-amid-criticism-coronavirus-concerns/30552387.html |date=14 April 2020 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=16 April 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2020 Kiribati parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]<ref name=Kiribati-Parl>{{cite news |title=Delayed start for Kiribati elections |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/413994/delayed-start-for-kiribati-elections |date=10 April 2020 |work=[[RNZ International|RNZ Pacific]] |access-date=10 April 2020}}</ref>
*15 April: [[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2020 South Korean legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |last=Bicker |first=Laura |title=Coronavirus: South Korea holds elections in masks and clinics |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52275993 |date=15 April 2020 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=16 April 2020}}</ref>
*19 April: [[Elections in Mali|Mali]], [[2020 Malian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
*21 April: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2020 Kiribati parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref name=Kiribati-Parl/>

==May==
*1 May: [[Elections in Palau|Palau]], [[2020 Palauan constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sudd.ch/event.php?lang=en&id=pw012020|title=Palau, 1. Mai 2020 : Festlegung der Hoheitsgewässer|date=May 2020 |language=de|access-date=22 September 2020}}</ref>
*20 May: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2020 Burundian general election|President and National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dw.com/en/burundians-vote-despite-coronavirus-outbreak/a-53479621|title=Burundians vote despite coronavirus outbreak|work=[[Deutsche Welle]]|date=20 May 2020}}</ref>
*25 May: [[Elections in Suriname|Suriname]], [[2020 Surinamese general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Suriname: Government drafting coronavirus protocol for elections |url=https://www.thedailyherald.sx/regional/suriname-government-drafting-coronavirus-protocol-for-elections |newspaper=St. Maarten Daily Herald |location=Philipsburg |date=28 April 2020 |access-date=9 May 2020}}</ref>
*30 May: ''[[Politics of Niue|Niue]], [[2020 Niuean general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tvniue.com/2019/12/premier-sir-toke-talagi-will-contest-2020-general-election|title=Premier Sir Toke Talagi Will Contest 2020 General Election|website=TVNiue|date=4 December 2019|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>

==June==
*5 June: [[Elections in Saint Kitts and Nevis|Saint Kitts and Nevis]], [[2020 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Bailey |first1=Elvin |title=Election Supervisor Explains Nomination, Voting Process |url=https://www.thestkittsnevisobserver.com/election-supervisor-explains-nomination-voting-process/ |date=29 May 2020 |newspaper=[[The St. Kitts-Nevis Observer]] |location=[[Basseterre]] |access-date=1 June 2020}}</ref>
*21 June: [[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2020 Serbian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Serbia to hold general election despite pandemic |url=https://apnews.com/3d528aad9d7e8944884143ddf96cef0d |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=4 May 2020 |access-date=4 May 2020}}</ref>
*22 June: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2020 Kiribati presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Two former allies to face off for Kiribati presidency |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/417282/two-former-allies-to-face-off-for-kiribati-presidency |date=22 May 2020 |work=[[RNZ International|RNZ Pacific]] |access-date=22 May 2020}}</ref>
*23 June: [[Elections in Malawi|Malawi]], [[2020 Malawian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |last=Khamula |first=Owen |title=June 23 for Malawi fresh presidential election endorsed by Parliamentary committee |url=https://www.nyasatimes.com/june-23-for-malawi-fresh-presidential-election-endorsed-by-parliamentary-committee/ |date=21 May 2020 |work=[[Nyasa Times]] |access-date=22 May 2020}}</ref>
*24 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2020 Mongolian legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://montsame.mn/en/read/212133|title=Election day proposed to be on June 24|work=[[Montsame]]|date=9 January 2020}}</ref>
*25 June – 1 July: [[Elections in Russia|Russia]], [[2020 Russian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Russians Start Voting On Reforms, Multiple Voting Already An Issue |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-voting-referendum-putin/30689554.html |date=25 June 2020 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=25 June 2020}}</ref>
*27 June: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2020 Icelandic presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.icelandreview.com/news/icelands-presidential-election-scheduled-for-june/|work=[[Iceland Review]]|title=Iceland's Presidential Election Scheduled for June|date=21 March 2020|access-date=15 April 2020}}</ref>
*28 June: [[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2020 Polish presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Poland presidential election heads for second round |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53215106 |date=29 June 2020 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=30 June 2020}}</ref>
*29 June: ''[[Elections in Anguilla|Anguilla]], [[2020 Anguillan general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web |title=Proclamation - (Appointment of the date for Election of the Assembly).pdf |url=http://www.gov.ai/documents/Proclamation%20-%20(Appointment%20of%20the%20date%20for%20Election%20of%20the%20Assembly).pdf |publisher=Governor of Anguilla |access-date=4 June 2020 |date=2 June 2020 |archive-date=4 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200604043639/http://www.gov.ai/documents/Proclamation%20-%20(Appointment%20of%20the%20date%20for%20Election%20of%20the%20Assembly).pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==July==
*5 July: 
**[[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2020 Croatian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Croatian president sets parliamentary vote for July 5 |url=https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/croatian-president-sets-parliamentary-vote-july-70783155 |date=20 May 2020 |work=ABC News |agency=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=May 20, 2020 |language=en}}</ref>
**[[Elections in the Dominican Republic|Dominican Republic]], [[2020 Dominican Republic general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Coronavirus: la présidentielle en République Dominicaine reportée au 5 juillet |url=http://www.rfi.fr/fr/ticker/coronavirus-la-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-en-r%C3%A9publique-dominicaine-report%C3%A9e-5-juillet |date=23 March 2020 |work=[[Radio France Internationale]] |language=fr |access-date=15 April 2020 |archive-date=14 April 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200414120046/http://www.rfi.fr/fr/ticker/coronavirus-la-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-en-r%C3%A9publique-dominicaine-report%C3%A9e-5-juillet |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*10 July: [[Elections in Singapore|Singapore]], [[2020 Singaporean general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50668633|title=Outcry as Google bans political advertising in Singapore as election looms|work=[[BBC News]]|date=5 December 2019}}</ref>
*12 July: [[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2020 Polish presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Poland election: Clash of ideals as voters choose head of state |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53379600 |date=12 July 2020 |work=[[BBC News]] |access-date=12 July 2020}}</ref>
*15 July: [[Elections in North Macedonia|North Macedonia]], [[2020 North Macedonian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |last=Jakov Marusic |first=Sinisa |title=North Macedonia Leaders Agree Election Date |url=https://balkaninsight.com/2020/06/15/north-macedonia-leaders-agree-election-date/ |date=15 June 2020 |work=[[Balkan Insight]] |location=[[Skopje]] |access-date=15 June 2020}}</ref>
*19 July: [[Elections in Syria|Syria]], [[2020 Syrian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://en.mehrnews.com/news/158439/Syria-s-Parliamentary-election-postponed-for-July-19 |title=Syria's Parliamentary election postponed for July 19 |date=7 May 2020 |work=[[Mehr News Agency]] |access-date=7 May 2020}}</ref>

==August==
*5 August: [[Elections in Sri Lanka|Sri Lanka]], [[2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-06-10|title=Sri Lanka's parliamentary elections fixed for August 5|url=https://www.newsfirst.lk/2020/06/10/general-election-on-august-5/|access-date=2020-06-10|work=Sri Lanka News - Newsfirst|language=en}}</ref>
*9 August: [[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2020 Belarusian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Belarus To Hold Presidential Election In August Despite Pandemic |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-to-hold-presidential-election-in-august-despite-pandemic/30601228.html |date=8 May 2020 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=8 May 2020}}</ref>
*10 August: [[Elections in Trinidad and Tobago|Trinidad and Tobago]], [[2020 Trinidad and Tobago general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://newsday.co.tt/2020/07/03/august-10-is-trinidad-and-tobago-election-day|title=August 10 is Trinidad and Tobago election day|work=[[Trinidad and Tobago Newsday]]|date=3 July 2020|access-date=5 July 2020}}</ref>
*11–12 August: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2020 Egyptian Senate election|Senate (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Egypt sets date for senate elections in August|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-politics-idUSKBN2450HH|date=5 July 2020|work=[[Reuters]]|access-date=5 July 2020|language=en}}</ref>
*30 August: 
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2020 Liechtenstein referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://vorarlberg.orf.at/stories/3061019/|title=Liechtenstein: Three referendums at the same time|work=[[ORF (broadcaster)|ORF Vorarlberg]]|date=16 August 2020|access-date=21 August 2020}} {{in lang|de}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Montenegro|Montenegro]], [[2020 Montenegrin parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Milo has decided: Montenegro is going to elections |url=https://srbin.info/politika/milo-odlucio-crna-gora-ide-na-izbore/ |date=20 June 2020 |website=SRBIN.INFO |access-date=21 June 2020}} {{in lang|sr}}</ref>

==September==
*3 September: [[Elections in Jamaica|Jamaica]], [[2020 Jamaican general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/lead-stories/20200811/jamaica-votes-general-election-september-3-2020|title=Jamaica Votes In General Election On September 3, 2020|work=[[The Gleaner]]|date=11 August 2020|access-date=13 August 2020}}</ref>
*8–9 September: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2020 Egyptian Senate election|Senate (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.alhurra.com/egypt/2020/07/04/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AE|title=Egypt sets the date for the Senate elections|work=[[Alhurra]]|date=4 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200705110847/https://www.alhurra.com/egypt/2020/07/04/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AE|access-date=6 July 2020|archive-date=2020-07-05}} {{in lang|ar}}</ref>
*11 September: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2020 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-03/16/c_138881055.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200623150721/http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-03/16/c_138881055.htm |url-status=dead |archive-date=June 23, 2020 |title=Update: Iran postpones 2nd round of parliamentary elections over COVID-19 |work=[[Xinhua News Agency]] |date=16 March 2020 |access-date=14 April 2020}}</ref>
*20–21 September: [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2020 Italian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Il 20 e 21 settembre ci sarà il referendum sul taglio del numero dei parlamentari |url=https://www.ilpost.it/2020/07/15/referendum-taglio-parlamentari-20-21-settembre/ |access-date=15 July 2020 |agency=[[Il Post]] |date=15 July 2020 |language=it}}</ref>
*24 September: ''[[Elections in the Falkland Islands|Falkland Islands]], [[2020 Falkland Islands electoral system referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Falklands moves to next COVID-19 response; March 26 referendum postponed for six months |url=https://en.mercopress.com/2020/03/21/falklands-moves-to-next-covid-19-response-march-26-referendum-postponed-for-six-months |access-date=26 March 2020 |work=MercoPress |date=21 March 2020}}</ref>
*27 September: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2020 Swiss referendums#September referendums|Referendums]]

==October==
*1 October: ''[[Elections in Bermuda|Bermuda]], [[2020 Bermudian general election|House of Assembly]]''
*2–3 October: [[Elections in Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2020 Czech Senate election|Senate (1st round)]]
*4 October: 
**[[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2020 Kyrgyz parliamentary election|<s>Parliament</s>]] (election nullified)<ref>{{cite news|title=Kyrgyzstan Annuls Results Of Parliamentary Elections After Night Of Deadly Protests|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/building-housing-kyrgyz-parliament-president-s-office-catches-fire-after-day-of-protests/30877477.html|date=6 October 2020|publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE/RL's Kyrgyz Service]]|access-date=6 October 2020|language=en}}</ref>
**''[[Elections in New Caledonia|New Caledonia]], [[2020 New Caledonian independence referendum|Independence Referendum]]''
*7 October: ''[[Elections in Guernsey|Guernsey]], [[2020 Guernsey general election|Legislature]]''
*9–10 October: [[Elections in Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2020 Czech Senate election|Senate (2nd round)]]
*11 October: 
**[[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2020 Lithuanian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
**''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2020 Northern Cypriot presidential election|President (1st round)]] and [[2020 Northern Cypriot constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]''
**[[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2020 Tajik presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Tajikistan's Parliament Sets October 11 As Date For Presidential Election|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-s-parliament-sets-october-11-as-date-for-presidential-election/30769277.html|work=Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|date=6 August 2020|access-date=13 August 2020}}</ref>
*17 October: [[Elections in New Zealand|New Zealand]], [[2020 New Zealand general election|Parliament]] and Referendums on [[2020 New Zealand cannabis referendum|cannabis]] and [[2020 New Zealand euthanasia referendum|euthanasia]]
*18 October: 
**[[Elections in Bolivia|Bolivia]], [[2020 Bolivian general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Bolivia election: Evo Morales' ally Luis Arce set for win |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54591963 |publisher=BBC World |date=19 October 2020 |access-date=20 October 2020}}</ref>
